collection.credit:
🌴 Role Models and Good Examples — 40 New Isola Events

Forty original events for your Virtual Villagers anthology, numbered RM-01 through RM-40. Each has three or four choices, with two possible outcomes per choice. The events emphasize everyday integrity, compassion, fairness, responsibility, and respect without requiring perfect outcomes.

ledger.text: EVENT RM-21  -  THE FAIR CONTEST SETUP:
ledger.why: the event's number and title (the title) and the SETUP: marker; the source puts the whole event on one line

collection.description: Several children prepare for a running contest, but one child worries that the uneven ground gives some runners an advantage.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Several children prepare for a running contest, but one child worries that the uneven ground gives some runners an advantage.

choices.label: Let the children decide on reasonable adjustments.
Ask a neutral adult to supervise.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The children agree on a clearer route before the race begins.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The ground remains uneven, so they choose a different activity.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The runners agree on a course everyone considers acceptable.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The discussion reveals different ideas of fairness, and the contest is postponed.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The adult helps settle the disagreement without choosing a favorite.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The children discover that they can resolve most of the issue themselves.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: Some children race while others help mark the route and record results.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: One child still feels left out, prompting the organizers to reconsider the plan.
